# Re-issued trust-anchor vectors (RFC 5280 6.1.1(d): anchor information is input, not a
# validated path edge). One EC P-256 root KEY is reused across several self-signed roots
# sharing the subject "CN=TlsLib Reissued Root", so a peer-sent copy that differs from the
# configured anchor only by serial/signature must still resolve to the configured anchor.
# Hierarchy: root_cert (anchor, serial 1, sha256) -> issuer_cert (serial 2) -> leaf_cert
# (serial 3, SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth). Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31.
#   root_reissued_cert      - same key + subject as root_cert, serial 4, sha256 self-signature
#   root_reissued_sha1_cert - same key + subject as root_cert, serial 5, sha1 self-signature
#   root_lookalike_cert     - same subject DN as root_cert but a DIFFERENT key (serial 6)
#   root2_cert              - an unrelated root ("CN=TlsLib Unrelated Root", serial 7)
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out root.key
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Reissued Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out root.pem
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out issuer.key
#   openssl req -new -key issuer.key -subj "/CN=TlsLib Reissued Issuer" -out issuer.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in issuer.csr -CA root.pem -CAkey root.key -set_serial 2 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile ca.ext -out issuer.pem
#     ca.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:true / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign /
#             subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out leaf.key
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA issuer.pem -CAkey issuer.key -set_serial 3 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth /
#               subjectAltName=DNS:localhost / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Reissued Root" -set_serial 4 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out root_reissued.pem
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha1 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Reissued Root" -set_serial 5 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out root_reissued_sha1.pem
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out lookalike.key
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key lookalike.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Reissued Root" -set_serial 6 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out root_lookalike.pem
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out root2.key
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root2.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Unrelated Root" -set_serial 7 -not_before NB -not_after NA -out root2.pem
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each *_cert field)
#   openssl pkey -in X.key -outform DER | xxd -p   (PKCS#8 DER, each *_key field)
